BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,567,000 of its ordinary shares on April 24, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The average price paid per share was 295.76 pence, with the lowest price at 281.20 pence and the highest at 298.60 pence. Following these transactions, Serco's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 994,569,014, with 8,177,000 shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights is now 994,569,014. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 24 April 2026 24 April 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 8,177,000 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 24 April 2026 is 994,569,014 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 8,177,000 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
